principle: No Windows-grade claim without physical Windows evidence.

phases.name: interactive-soak
fail_on: unresponsive UI > 10s unrelated to OS modal UI

phases.name: runtime-health-cycles
assertions: working runtime is preserved on failed candidate switch

phases.name: forced-runtime-recovery
assertions: replacement runtime becomes healthy within configured recovery bound

phases.name: mission-restart-recovery
assertions: material action is re-observed before retry

phases.name: host-pressure
assertions: background inference concurrency decreases under elevated pressure
low-priority council/verifier inference is abortable under critical pressure
Vision is blocked/unloaded before desktop responsiveness is sacrificed
download concurrency is reduced under pressure

promotion_rule: Every required phase must have captured evidence and zero unresolved required failures. Static/cross-build PASS cannot substitute for a physical Windows phase.
